notes: CONFORMS since kb/Work PB5377. RECEIVE INTO hands the MCS the receiving item through OperandText.RecordAreaImage with AreaUse.Receiving, so a group that holds its own OCCURS DEPENDING ON object is a receiving group of its maximum length (VI.5.8.4 GR3b), the sizing PlaceRenderer.WriteGroupImage applies to the store back. The golden's group GOD (GN, then GT up to nine times) receives a nine-character message and segment as TEXT LENGTH 0009 with END KEY 2 and 1, the whole text in GOD(1:9).

next.reason: 1985: "transferred to the receiving character positions of the area referenced by identifier-1 aligned to the left without space fill"; 2023: "Communication module (CD/MCS queues) dropped; new RECEIVE says only "The content of identifier-1 is the content of the message sent by that SEND statement"". The 2023 RECEIVE is a different run-unit messaging feature, not the 1985 CD-based statement, and it states no rule on left alignment or on omitting space fill.
